description: A simple single-purpose agent for testing

answers.business_process: Customer support for a small SaaS company. Customers ask about billing, account access, and feature requests.
answers.actors: Customers via web chat. Support team reviews escalated cases in Salesforce.
answers.systems: Case object, Account object, Knowledge articles for FAQ.
answers.failure_modes: Escalate to human if customer mentions cancellation or legal. If knowledge search returns no results, apologize and create a case.
